result.topic_en: Draft notes on the solution of the equations of air motion (from §1, presumably of Riemann's paper on plane air waves of finite amplitude), arguing that the quantities p and q must become discontinuous over time, producing sudden compressions (shocks), followed by scattered geometric sketches.

items.english: The law by which these functions change with time shows, however, that they must almost always become discontinuous with time, so that sudden compressions and changes of velocity of the air particles take place.
